text:
Alex K: :rotating_light: Seeing a ~15% jump in 503s for hosted inference since the staged toggle went out ~5m ago. Affected route: `model-infer-v2`. Anyone on this?
Maya R: Confirmed. Spike started right after the canary flag flip. 503s mostly gateway-level, not model containers.
Jordan (support): We already have 3 customer escalations (acct: acme-inc, betaapp) reporting timeouts + 5xx. They're waiting for ETA.
Priya S: Timeline: at 2391234550 ops toggled `feature.routing_v2=true` for canary (10% traffic). Quick repro:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "X-Route-Variant: v2" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
content-type: application/json
{"error":"gateway_error","code":503}
```
Logs show a short stack in the gateway: `auth header truncated -> downstream return 503` — suspect header propagation change in routing.
SRE-Oncall: Looking at proxy logs: a subset of requests lost `Authorization` during header rewrite when `X-Route-Variant` present. Correlation: requests with `X-Route-Variant: v2` -> auth header trimmed -> upstream auth fails -> converted to 503 at gateway. Pushing grep: `grep "X-Route-Variant" /var/log/proxy/*.log | grep 503`
deploy-bot: rollout:feature.routing_v2 -> canary group updated by ops (commit c4f2a1).
Alex K: OK rollback plan: revert `feature.routing_v2` to false for canary, hold rollout, and re-run a small canary after fixing header rewrite. Command: `./tooling/rollout rollback --flag=feature.routing_v2 --groups=canary`
Maya R: I'll run rollback now and coordinate with infra. tagging @SRE-Oncall to watch metrics.
Jordan (support): I'll notify the affected customers and open incident tickets. Please confirm ETA and whether to issue a status update.
Priya S: Repro steps for devs: in staging set `X-Forwarded-Authorization: keep` in proxy config or add header passthrough rule. Example diff snippet that fixes it:
```
- rewrite_headers: drop Authorization when X-Route-Variant
+ rewrite_headers: passthrough Authorization if X-Route-Variant
```
SRE-Oncall: Rolling rollback now (starting 2391234572). ETA 3-5m to remove flag from canary. Will monitor `503_rate` and `auth_fail_rate`.
deploy-bot: rollback job started (job id rb-2024031).
Maya R: Rollback done at 2391234590, canary reverted to stable routing. Watching metrics...
SRE-Oncall: `503_rate` down from 14% -> 0.8% in 2m. Auth failures returned to baseline.
Alex K: Great. Next steps: patch header-rewrite unit and integration tests, add canary gate to assert auth header passthrough, then re-rollout with 1% -> 5% steps.
Jordan (support): Sending status update to customers now; will keep them posted on fix timeline.
Priya S: I'll open a PR with the header fix and add an e2e that covers `X-Route-Variant` header paths.
Maya R: Thanks all — incident closed after monitoring window. :white_check_mark:
